captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a parametric timing pulley or flanged spur gear. It features a central cylindrical gear body with fine, straight axial teeth. The gear is sandwiched between two flat, circular flanges (fringes) that extend outward past the gear's outer diameter. A central shaft hole runs through the entire height, featuring a flat D-cut profile on one side of the inner bore to prevent shaft slippage.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric timing pulley or flanged gear in OpenSCAD. Key parameters should include the number of teeth (nt), gear height (gh), gear diameter (gd), shaft diameter (sd), fringe thickness (ggdt), number of fringes (nf, up to 2), and a toggle for a D-cut shaft hole.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main difference() block. The base structure is a union of a central cylinder representing the gear core and up to two thin cylinders representing the protective flanges (fringes). A central cylinder is subtracted to create the shaft hole. A for-loop subtracts rotated cylinders along the outer perimeter to form the gear gaps, while another for-loop adds cylinders to form the gear teeth. Finally, if enabled, a cube is subtracted from the inner bore to create the flat D-cut profile.
